name: skillguard-ai
description: Offline security scanner for AI agent skills. Detects prompt injection, secrets, reverse shells, destructive commands, hidden Unicode and supply-chain risks before an agent installs or runs a skill.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run benchmark && npm pack --dry-run
